metadata.name: Rulkov Map
metadata.author: Rulkov, N.F.
metadata.description: Rulkov 2002 three-branch fast/slow map with source reset-branch events

dynamics.x: (alpha / (1.0 - x) + y + I) if x <= 0 else (alpha + y + I if x < alpha + y + I else -1.0)

extensions.input_contract: I is the paper's fast beta_n channel; sigma is the static slow control.
extensions.event_contract: An event marks the pre-update state occupying the rightmost reset branch, as defined by Rulkov 2002.
extensions.identity_note: The former configurable upward-x crossing is retained separately as SCUpwardCrossingRulkovMapNeuron.
extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Class-correct validation uses a bounded short-window trajectory and exact reset-branch event vector. Long-window event-count parity is not used as a chaotic-map equivalence claim.
